builder.setup_create_title: Create a knowledge base through conversation
builder.setup_config_title: Configure the knowledge base through conversation
builder.setup_description: Choose the runtime and model the builder runs on.
builder.intro_create: What kind of knowledge base do you want? Pick a direction and I will draft the name, purpose and schema, then we refine them together.
builder.intro_config: I will change the purpose and schema to match what you need. Start from a question below, or say what you want to change.

dev.title: Engineering knowledge base
dev.description: System architecture, services and interfaces, runbooks, technical decisions

qa.title: Testing knowledge base
qa.description: Test design methods, test environments, regression checklists, defect reviews

product.title: Product knowledge base
product.description: Feature descriptions, business rules, billing rules, customer replies

team.title: Team knowledge base
team.description: Shared by engineering, testing and product, separated by domain tags

questions.readers: Who reads this knowledge base, and what do they look up most?
questions.scope: What belongs here, and what does not?
questions.structure: How should pages be organised: by system module, business flow or team?
questions.writing: What are the rules for citations and writing?

panel.title: Knowledge base configuration
panel.name: Name
panel.generated_placeholder: Generated after you describe your needs
panel.slug_invalid: Use lowercase letters, digits and hyphens
panel.schema_default_hint: Uses the built-in maintenance rules, which cannot be edited and the builder does not change. Switch to Custom to adapt them to your team.
panel.schema_placeholder: Drafted from the built-in schema after you describe your needs

discard.description: The conversation and the configuration on the right will be deleted permanently.

expand.edit_hint: Changes go back to the configuration on the right and take effect when saved
expand.read_only_hint: The default schema can only be viewed. To change it, switch to Custom on the right first

errors.slug_taken: This directory name is already used in the workspace
errors.conflict: Someone else saved this configuration after you opened it. Reload to see their changes.
errors.forbidden: Only the knowledge base creator or a workspace owner or admin can configure it
errors.create_failed: Could not create the knowledge base

welcome.created: Knowledge base “{{name}}” has been created. Here is how to use it.
welcome.guide_title: How to use this knowledge base

ingest.title: Ingest sources
ingest.description: Start a knowledge base job and hand issues, chats, uploaded files or web pages to an agent. It writes the knowledge into pages and cites a source for every fact.

review.title: Takes effect after review
review.description: An agent's changes go into a draft first. You review it and submit it; it takes effect once the knowledge base creator or an owner or admin merges it.

read.title: Read and annotate
read.description: When something is wrong or outdated, select the sentence and add an annotation. Annotations can be handed to an agent in one click.

maintain.title: Scheduled maintenance
maintain.description: Set up a scheduled ingest and a scheduled health check, and the knowledge base keeps up with the latest issues and code.

annotation.compose_hint: Agents see this sentence when they handle it
